welcome_lead: Polar bears and camels live in opposite worlds — and both are perfectly built for it.

walkthroughs.body_html: Polar bears have a thick coat, a blubber layer and large furry paws to spread weight on ice. White fur camouflages them on snow.
Camels store fat in their hump, close their nostrils against sand, and can drink huge amounts of water at once. Long legs lift them above hot sand.
Desert lizards burrow during the day. Many small mammals are nocturnal to avoid the heat.
